text_block_list.text: ...oodbye.
So, this is goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The ocean is blue and the ground is soft
beneath
my feet. There's salty sea air all
around.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I make out the figure of a person waving

reluctantly. I look on as she turns around
and
walks away... towards the sea.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel the urge to stop her, but I can't
get the
words out. My legs won't move
either, and my
arms won't lift.
Remember me... Okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sound of the waves gets louder. Her
voice is
drowned out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My vision grows blurry. Everything turns
white
and fades to nothing, until...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I find myself in my office in the late
afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sit up quickly. I must have been
dreaming. The
moment I realize that, the
events of the dream
drain from my
memory like water.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I was trying to keep someone
from
leaving.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...But who could it have been? The
harder I try to
remember, the foggier my
memory gets. I can't
remember anymore.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I realize no good will come of obsessing
over my
dream, so I decide to work on
the blog as usual.
However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I check some other sites, but I can access
them
without issue. And that's when a
thought occurs
to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It felt like it made sense to look at the
blog... but
what's the blog for in the first
place?
choice_data_list: そもそもなぜブログを……？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'm forgetting something, but I
don't
know what...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look outside to see that it's a clear and
sunny
day. But when I open the window
to calm myself...
choice_data_list: （疲れているのかもしれない）

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoooosh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A sudden gust of wind blows into my
office,
scattering the books, papers, and
doll on my desk
across the floor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I quickly shut the window and pick up all
my
things. When I reach for the doll,
though, I find it
surprisingly heavy...
I think that's safest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...And I hear what sounds like someone's
voice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A scene slowly starts to form in my mind.
I hear
something. I desperately try to
listen closer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Soon enough... I hear the distinct sound
of
cheering.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume races across the turf.
She kicks
up the dirt with all her might,
pumping her legs
over and over and
speeding up in the blink of an
eye.
Raaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She makes a startling dash for the finish
line,
outpacing everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Here's Aston Machan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I suddenly find myself standing up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
How could I have forgotten? Aston

Machan—that's who I saw in my dream.
And the
blog, too... it's a record of her
daily life.
choice_data_list: アストンマーチャンだ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm struck by an awful feeling I can't
ignore. I try
to get in touch with her, but
there's no answer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to stand still, I head out to find
Aston
Machan.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume that looks like this doll? Hmm... I feel like I've seen someone like that before...

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper A
text_block_list.text:
This doll does look a bit like someone I
saw
playing with a cat the other day...
Nah, maybe
that was someone else.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper B
text_block_list.text: Nope, haven't seen anyone like that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Aston Machan is nowhere to be found.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Desperately trying to string together my
hazy
memories, I think of her favorite
places and the
sights she likes to see...
Where would she go?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure why the ocean came to
mind. But for
whatever reason, I feel sure
that's the answer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I find her there, standing all alone on
the dark
shore.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wasting no time on questions, I sprint
straight
over to her.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Never mind, it doesn't matter. This is it
for me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I did think it was a little strange.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Spring and I were getting along even
worse than
usual. And the sound of the
waves has been
getting closer and
closer...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The sound called to me. I followed it
and I ended
up here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan looks out to the sea in
silence.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's a little soon... but I suppose that's
life.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone starts upstream and flows
downstream.
It's the natural way of
things...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't understand what she's saying, but
I don't
like the sound of this decision
she's making.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: So, this is goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan turns around. There's a
single
thought in my mind—"I have to
stop her."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: 『スプリンターズS』でのリベンジは？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She vowed to enter it at the
Takamatsunomiya
Kinen and reaffirmed
that decision at the Fan
Fest. She
promised to make it a race to
remember.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...It's a shame, but there's nothing else I
can do.
Machan did her best.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I would've liked that, but I've already
accepted
that it won't happen now.
choice_data_list: URA公式マスコットになる夢は

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
choice_data_list: ウルトラスーパーマスコットの夢は！

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...It's okay.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Because you're around. I know that as
long as
you're here, I'll never fade away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I've heard her say something like
that
before.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In other words, Machan will never
disappear as
long as you're around.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: That's why... it's going to be fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She smiles, as if at peace. I think I may
have
inadvertently nudged her closer
towards her
decision.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Please tell everyone all about me,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My response spills out before I can
think.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's right—Aston Machan. Not anyone
else. Not
Vodka. Not Daiwa Scarlet.
choice_data_list: アストンマーチャンは、ここからなんだ
アストンマーチャンは、ここからなんだよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's the one I see racing across the turf.
Filling
the crowd with anticipation as
their hearts pound
with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She kicks up the soil, sprints across the
dirt in the
blink of an eye...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And inspires dreams in my heart, again
and again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She shines on forever, for all to see.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...I'm just getting started.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She goes quiet for a while, seemingly
unsure of
what to do. The silence
continues for some time,
until...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She leans toward me, gazing deep into
my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'm still there.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In your eyes—I'm still there, shining
away.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: And that's still... not enough for you.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Really? I see. Well, that...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...That makes things difficult.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with those words, Aston Machan
turns her
back on the sea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'll just have to ignore it. I'll pretend I
can't hear
the call.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What else can I do? You really are a
strange
person, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Even after reaching the mouth of the
river, you
turn back to face upstream.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The water may well surge up and drag
me back
out to sea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
My boat might spring one leak after
another, and
its sail might break in two...
But still, even so...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: My story won't end here.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Let's make sure of that together, shall
we?
